**Renewable Energy Study Guide**

### Introduction to Renewable Energy

Renewable energy is a crucial aspect of modern power systems, offering a sustainable alternative to traditional fossil fuels. The National Renewable Energy Laboratory has published reports on renewable electricity generation, highlighting its potential and challenges.

### Modeling of Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems

Deshmukh and Deshmukh (2008) discussed the modeling of hybrid renewable energy systems in their paper "Modeling of hybrid renewable energy systems" (Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, Vol. 12, Issue 1, pp. 235-249). This study provides valuable insights into the integration of multiple renewable energy sources.

### Stochastic Processes in Renewable Energy

Doob (1953) wrote about stochastic processes, which are essential in understanding the variability of renewable energy sources. This knowledge is crucial in predicting and managing the output of renewable energy systems.

### International Energy Outlook

The Energy Information Administration (EIA) published the International Energy Outlook 2011, which provides an overview of the global energy landscape. The report is available at http://www.eia.gov/forecasts/ieo/.

### Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Sinks

The United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) released the Inventory of U.S. Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Sinks: 1990-2009. This report can be accessed at http://epa.gov/climatechange/emissions/usinventoryreport.html.

### Challenges of Renewable Energy Integration
